scripts.release: gh workflow run release.yml --ref main && sleep 5 && gh run watch $(gh run list --workflow release.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId -q ".[0].databaseId") --exit-status
scripts.release:dry-run: gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f dry_run=true && sleep 5 && gh run watch $(gh run list --workflow release.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId -q ".[0].databaseId") --exit-status
